security_rules: Store credential values only in the orchestrator credential store.
Persist and export credential aliases only, never secret values or local key paths.
Do not log Authorization headers or raw credential objects.
Do not copy credentials into model blocks, fixtures, workflow JSON, or Git.
operational_notes: The secondary credential is passive and is used only for eligible failover.
A malformed payload or invalid model is not fixed by changing credentials.
A malformed model response uses repair or model fallback, not credential fallback.
Two keys can share an account-level or project-level quota; independent quota is not assumed.
Never fail back to a credential already used by the same request.
